description: This file defines the internal implementation of the ClientDirectory class within the Orleans Runtime GrainDirectory namespace. It manages routing information for clients, monitors cluster membership, communicates with remote directories, and periodically propagates routing updates across the cluster ring topology. It implements routing lookup, updates, publish mechanisms, and lifecycle participation for the silo's client directory functionality.

classes.name: ClientDirectory
classes.description: A sealed class implementing the client routing directory for Orleans, managing client routes, cluster membership updates, and routing propagation.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up the addresses for a given GrainId, first locally then remotely with retries if needed.

methods.name: TryLocalLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find routes for a given GrainId within the local snapshot.

methods.name: EnsureRefreshed
methods.description: Ensures the routing table is up to date by comparing cluster version and connected client version.

methods.name: OnUpdateClientRoutes
methods.description: Updates the routing table based on remote updates and optionally triggers publication.

methods.name: GetClientRoutes
methods.description: Provides routing data for silos based on known versions, returning updates as needed.

methods.name: UpdateRoutingTable
methods.description: Atomically updates the routing table with cluster membership info, connected clients, and remote directories.

methods.name: GetConnectedClients
methods.description: Returns the current set of connected clients and its version, updating if changes are detected.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop managing cluster membership updates, timer ticks, and route publishing.

methods.name: ShouldPublish
methods.description: Determines if the routing table should be published to other silos based on state changes.

methods.name: SchedulePublishUpdates
methods.description: Schedules the route publication process if not already scheduled.

methods.name: PublishUpdates
methods.description: Publishes the current routing table to the successor silo, minimizing data transfer.
